title: Gushing Over Magical Girls Season 2 Reveals New Visual, Trailer, 2027 Release Date
content:
Gushing Over Magical Girls Season 2 revealed a new visual and trailer that announce the 2027 release date.

The cast will reprise their roles for the sequel:

• Fuka Izumi as Utena Hiiragi/Magia Baiser

• Misato Fukuen as Venalita

• Aoi Koga as Kiwi Araga / Leopard

• Shiori Sugiura as Korisu Morino / Nero Alice

• Yuka Aisaka as Matama Akoya/Loco Musica

• Minami Tsuda as Nemo Anemo/Leberblume

• Kaori Maeda as Haruka Hanabishi/Magia Magenta

• Mayuko Kazama as Sayo Minakami / Magia Azul

• Misaki Ikeda as Kaoruko Tenkawa / Magia Sulfur

Asahi Productions animated the first season with Masato Suzuki and Atsushi Otsuki as directors. Noboru Kimura was in charge of the series composition, while Tomoka Otaki was on character designs and Yasuharu Takanashi , Akinari Suzuki, and Johannes Nilsson composed the music.

Gushing Over Magical Girls anime is based on a magical girl manga series by Akihiro Ononaka. It initially began its serialization on Takeshobo’s Storia Dash website in March 2019. J-Novel Club licenses the manga in English and they describe the plot as follows: “Hi, I’m Hiiragi Utena. I’m a normal magical-girl-loving middle school girl—or at least I was, but then some talking mascot showed up out of the blue and cast a spell on me! Now’s my chance to join my beloved magical girls as…a villain? Hang on, something’s wrong with my outfit! This can’t be happening! Watch this shy magical-girl fan transform into a sadistic dominatrix! When good and evil collide, who will be the one to submit?!”
author: Anime Corner

title: Gushing Over Magical Girls Anime's 2nd Season Debuts in 2027
content:
Kadokawa revealed on Saturday that the second season of the anime based on Akihiro Ononaka 's Gushing Over Magical Girls ( Mahō Shōjo ni Akogarete ) manga will debut in 2027, under the title Mahō Shōjo ni Akogarete Season 2 ( Gushing Over Magical Girls Season 2 ). The new season was first announced in October 2024.

The company revealed the news in a birthday celebration video for Magia Baiser on Saturday.

Kadokawa also revealed an "ultra teaser visual," and confirmed the new season's returning cast and staff. The returning cast includes:

• Fūka Izumi as Utena Hiiragi/Magia Baiser

• Aoi Koga as Kiwi Araga/Leopard

• Shiori Sugiura as Korisu Morino/Nero Alice

• Yuka Aisaka as Matama Akoya/Loco Musica

• Minami Tsuda as Nemo Anemo/Leberblume

• Kaori Maeda as Haruka Hanabishi/Magia Magenta

• Mayuko Kazama as Sayo Minakami/Magia Azul

• Misaki Ikeda as Kaoruko Tenkawa/Magia Sulfur

• Misato Fukuen as Venalita

• Kana Asumi as Vatz

Masato Suzuki and Atsushi Ōtsuki are both returning to co-direct the anime at Asahi Production . Noboru Kimura is again overseeing the series scripts, and Yasuka Ōtaki is again designing the characters.

The first season debuted on the AT-X channel in January 2024, and the series also aired on Tokyo MX , BS11 , Sun TV , and KBS Kyoto . The anime has three different versions: the TV broadcast version, the "gushing" version on streaming services, and the "ultra-gushing" version on Blu-ray Disc and DVD. The TV broadcast version censors the audio and visuals, the "gushing" version censors the audio and some of the visuals, and the "ultra-gushing" version does not censor either.

HIDIVE streamed the anime as it aired in Japan, and has the series' "gushing" version available for streaming.

Ononaka launched the manga in Takeshobo 's Manga Life Storia magazine in 2019. After the magazine ceased publication in July 2019, the manga moved to the Storia Dash website.

The manga went on hiatus in March 2024 due to Ononaka's health, and resumed serialization in October 2025 on Takeshobo 's Takecomi! website .

J-Novel Club licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Hi, I'm Hiiragi Utena. I'm a normal magical-girl-loving middle school girl—or at least I was, but then some talking mascot showed up out of the blue and cast a spell on me! Now's my chance to join my beloved magical girls as...a villain? Hang on, something's wrong with my outfit! This can't be happening! Watch this shy magical-girl fan transform into a sadistic dominatrix! When good and evil collide, who will be the one to submit?!

Takeshobo published the manga's 13th volume in Japan on September 16. The manga has more than 3 million copies in circulation worldwide, including digital copies sold.
author: ANN

title: 5 Classic ’90s English Dub Anime That Surpass the Originals
content:
The debate over which is better — subbed or dubbed anime — has persisted for years, but these English dubs streaming on Crunchyroll are some of the best in the game. Many anime fans are steadfast in the belief that all series should be viewed in their original Japanese forms. And there are plenty of reasons subtitled anime might be preferable to their dubbed counterparts. A lot can go wrong when dubbing a series, from the translated scripts not getting the story and dialogue right to voice actors missing the emotional mark. However, as anime has become more popular in the West, the quality of English dubs has improved, with studios putting more time, effort, and resources into their creation.

Some of the greatest English dubs are, sadly, not streaming on Crunchyroll as of this writing. Series like Steins;Gate and Death Note are known for their high-quality dubs, but they’re either not available in their entirety or aren’t on the streamer at all. Fortunately, there are still plenty of incredible English dubs to dig into, whether you’re experiencing these stories for the first time or looking to revisit them in another language. From a sci-fi anime about defeating tyranny to one of the most impactful titles of the ’90s, these are well worth your time.

5) Cowboy Bebop

Sunrise’s Cowboy Bebop takes place in a futuristic setting where humanity has begun to live out in space, and going right along with that has been a new wave of crime that necessitates the use of bounty hunters called Cowboys. Among those Cowboys are series protagonist Spike Spiegel and the rest of the crew of the Bebop , and the series follows their episodic adventures chasing after bounties to make a living while occasionally confronting the demons of their pasts. With its stellar writing, gorgeous animation, direction, and masterful use of Western themes in its writing and overall aesthetic, this anime stands out as one of the most unique and engaging anime of all time, with an incredible cast to flesh it out at every turn. Not only is Cowboy Bebop Shinichiro Watanabe’s most iconic anime, but it’s a series often considered one of the greatest anime of all time. Even after 25 years, it deserves to be recognized.

4) Trigun

As a sci-fi classic, Trigun was a bigger hit in the West compared to Japan, thanks to the Western inspirations behind the series. However, the original anime was significantly different from the manga, which is why a reboot was released much later. Since the franchise maintained a dedicated global fanbase throughout the decades, many ended up loving Trigun Stampede as well. The story follows Vash the Stampede, a man with an astronomical bounty on his head for being a merciless villain. Those who have only heard his name know him for being ruthless enough to leave a trail of blood in his wake. However, in reality, Vash is a soft-natured man who claims to have never killed a person and even hates violence.

3) Dragon Ball Z

Akira Toriyama’s Dragon Ball is one of the most influential anime and manga franchises of all time, which has inspired several mangaka to this day. The series popularized several Shonen tropes, such as transformations, which are still famously used in many series. While the original Dragon Ball anime set the foundation of the story, the sequel anime, titled Dragon Ball Z , played a crucial role in popularizing the franchise in the West. The story takes place four years after the events of Dragon Ball , where Goku is married to Chi-Chi and has a son named Gohan. However, his peaceful life is jeopardized when aliens from outer space threaten Earth and unveil Goku’s origins.

2) Yu Yu Hakusho

On the surface, Yu Yu Hakusho doesn’t seem much different from a majority of Shonen series that follow the protagonist’s journey after they gain newfound powers in the very first episode. However, there’s one thing that completely sets it apart from any other show. Instead of going through the conventional route of having the protagonist gain power after some unexpected encounter, the story begins with the death of Yusuke Urameshi. As a 14-year-old delinquent, he used to spend his days skipping school and causing trouble for those around him. He would even get into fights with his rival Kazuma Kuwabara. If that wasn’t bad enough, Yusuke would also ridicule his childhood friend Keiko Yukimura with every opportunity he got.

1) Outlaw Star

Space western anime were all the rage in the 1990s, and this theme is appreciated even to this day, as witnessed by the huge popularity of Cowboy Bebop . Unfortunately, Outlaw Star didn’t stand the test of time even though both series were released in the same year. While Outlaw Star is more or less forgotten among new anime fans, it still has a small but dedicated fanbase. However, this underrated gem was once one of the most popular space anime, loved for its intriguing adventure with a blend of fun and space exploration. The story follows a young man, Gene Starwing, who always dreamed of piloting his own ship across the galaxy, but has been stuck doing odd jobs with his partner James Hawking. The duo’s life takes a drastic turn after accepting a job from Rachel Sweet, who turns out to be a treasure-hunting outlaw. While Gene and James are only tasked with protecting Melina, a mysterious girl, they soon get entangled in more dangers than they bargained for.

Which ’90s anime English dub do you think did the best job of staying true to the original story? Is there another classic you would add to the list? Share your picks in the comments below!

title: Solo Leveling Studio’s Next Big Anime Is Everything My Dress-Up Darling Couldn’t Be
content:
Now that 2026 is approaching its end, the anime industry is getting ready for its upcoming releases for 2027, including a gorgeous anime from A-1 Pictures. This is the same studio behind Solo Leveling , and it’s known for several acclaimed shows. The studio’s latest project, Bless , is one of the most anticipated anime of 2027. It was already scheduled for the Winter 2027 lineup, and now that the season is closer than ever, the studio confirmed its release date in a new trailer. The gorgeous trailer sheds more light on the main characters before confirming that the anime will premiere on January 8th, 2027.

The official X handle of the anime also shared a key visual along with the confirmation that the episodes will broadcast every Friday at 11:30 P.M. on Fuji TV’s Noitamina network. The new trailer also introduces the cast and crew, along with a few new glimpses at the main characters. The anime has already gathered a lot of attention not only because of its visuals and unique premise, but also because the studio behind Solo Leveling is producing it, which is enough to pique fans’ interest. Established in 2005, this renowned studio is responsible for creating several modern classics such as Kaguya-sama: Love Is War , Your Lie in April , and many more.

Bless Challenges the Narrow Beauty Standards in the Fashion Industry

The anime is based on Yukino Sonoyama’s acclaimed Shonen manga, which began serialization in Kodansha’s monthly Shonen Sirius magazine in 2022. The story centers around 15-year-old Aia Udagawa , who has been chosen as a model for the Aoi Festival Artist Contest due to his previous experience. However, amid his inner struggles, he notices Jin Sumisaki, a tall and awkward girl who appears embarrassed about her appearance. The two of them are paired as a model and stylist, which becomes a major turning point in their lives. While Udagawa regrets abandoning his dream after convincing himself he has no talent, Sumisaki lacks the confidence to work as a model despite having the stunning features that make her stand out from the crowd. The story continues as the duo embraces their dreams while giving each other the push needed to break free from the shackles of self-doubt.

Bless Has a Better Story and More Emotional Depth Than My Dress-Up Darling

My Dress-Up Darling is a popular cosplay drama centering around Wakana Gojo, a high school boy whose hobby is crafting traditional Hina dolls, but he is socially awkward and afraid of people judging him. However, Marin, a popular and outgoing classmate, discovers his skills and urges him to help her out. As an avid cosplayer with no sewing experience, she seeks his help in making costumes. Despite contrasting personalities, they soon become friends, and Wakana learns to appreciate his talent more. Marin gets to try unique and creative cosplays. As the story continues, their relationship deepens, making the series a heartwarming and comedic story. Written and illustrated by Shinichi Fukuda, the manga was published in Young Gangan, a magazine owned by Square Enix Holdings. The manga debuted in January 2018 and reached its conclusion in March 2025. While the series has incredible reviews from fans and critics, it’s also highly controversial for its heavy use of fan service, especially since the character in question is a 15-year-old girl.

Bless is a truly unique shonen series. While the demographic is no stranger to series that dip away from traditional action stories and explore coming-of-age and slice-of-life themes, the narrative and themes Bless chooses to explore are things that are stereotypically attributed to shoujo manga. This isn’t a bad thing, either, as Bless is a masterclass example of storytelling in how it introduces its lead characters and explores the two of them navigating the makeup industry. Aia is a young man who aspires to be a makeup artist; while this isn’t as uncommon as it used to be, it’s still a relatively unconventional career path for a young man to pursue.

He enters high school decides to push his passion as deep down as it can go until he meets Jun, a reserved girl with a face covered in freckles who hides herself away due to her own insecurities. Somehow, Aia becomes captivated by Jun and convinces her to enter their school’s fashion competition together, with Aia doing Jun’s makeup for the show. The two make a powerful team and embark on a journey of self-discovery and personal growth as they begin to dominate the fashion industry in Japan. The series focuses on learning to trust and open up, and embracing every creative face of one’s personality.

Do you think Bless has what it takes to stand out more than My Dress-Up Darling ? And what are you most excited to see in its adaptation? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

title: Fan-Favorite Anime Confirms Season 4 Return After 3 Years With First Trailer – Watch
content:
Laid-Back Camp , one of the most beloved slice-of-life anime of all time , is returning with a Season 4 next year. With the anime industry oversaturated with Shonen and action series, Laid-Back Camp is a breath of fresh air with its cozy and heartwarming vibe. Based on an ongoing manga written and illustrated by Afro, the anime released its first season in 2018 and continued to return with new seasons. The series isn’t a ground-breaking hit,3 but it has a decent enough fan base thanks to its exceptional storytelling with a simplistic and realistic plot.

The anime has already released three seasons so far, and the latest one debuted in 2024. A sequel season was officially confirmed in November 2024 with a new visual, only a few months after Season 3 reached its conclusion. However, it took a long while for the series to share updates on the upcoming season. The fourth season shared its latest trailer along with a gorgeous key visual. The official X handle of the anime also shared that the fourth season will premiere in April as part of the Spring 2027 anime lineup. The exact release date will only be announced a few weeks before the premiere, but so far, the trailer shares major details on the series and everything we can expect.

Laid-Back Camp Season 4 Is Making a Massive Change in Season 4

The fourth season will be produced by FuRyu Pictures, a fairly new studio which was established in June last year. This also explains the delay in announcing the release window of the fourth season since the anime was going to be created by another studio. This isn’t the first time the series has gone through this change . While C-Station was responsible for the first two seasons and the feature-length movie, the anime was handed over to Studio 8-bit in Season 3. It’s no secret to anime fans, especially after the release of Blue Lock Season 2, that the animation studio is dealing with several production issues, which is why they couldn’t continue working on Laid-Back Camp after the third season. However, although FuRyu Pictures is a fairly new studio that hasn’t released a number of critically acclaimed series, the trailer gives fans the first glimpse at the animation, and it does look better than before. We can also expect the fourth season of the anime to land on Crunchyroll after its premiere, where you can also catch up with the first three seasons and the OVAs.

Laid-Back Camp Remains One of the Best Slice-of-Life of All Time

This heartwarming story follows Rin Shima, who, unlike other girls her age, spends her days camping alone at the base of Mount Fuji instead of going on a fancy vacation. She excels at basically everything one needs to do to survive out in the woods, including pitching her tent and gathering firewood. However, when her plans are disrupted by a simple mistake, she asks a nearby young girl for help, and the story continues as they enjoy the chilly night together. Aside from portraying the practical and realistic components of camping, the series stands out for the way its main characters interact with and cooperate with one another during a camping trip. It blends the tried-and-true “coming-of-age” tale with very valuable life lessons. Laid-Back Camp is worth giving a shot, especially for those who are hoping to take a break from the thrilling action series that’s dominating the industry.

title: Dragon Ball Super Needs to Figure Out What’s Next for Broly
content:
The reintroduction to Broly brought up a lot of possibilities when it comes to his future in the Dragon Ball universe, but all of that is still unknown. The Legendary Super Saiyan appeared in Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero , but in a cameo role. His small storyline focused on controlling his insane powers. Broly appeared to learn a lot while watching an educational fight between Vegeta and Goku. The two Saiyans were showing him how to fight without destroying the environment around him. He genuinely seemed interested in how to control his powers, but beyond that, he sat on the sidelines.

His story stops there for the time being, however. New Broly didn’t get a fight in Super Dragon Ball Heroes even if his non-canon counterpart did. The evil Broly from Dragon Ball Z resurfaced for the first time since his movie trilogy igniting rumors about a multiverse clash. Furthermore, the introduction of Cumber could add another monster Saiyan matchup to the future. Nothing is confirmed yet, but there are a lot of directions this could go and Dragon Ball really needs to figure it out.

Broly Set To Join The Z Fighters

The Z Fighters are known for bringing former opponents into their group. Tien, Chiaotzu, Piccolo, Vegeta and Androids 17 and 18 were all added after initially fighting against Goku and his friends. Broly looks like he could follow the same path into the squad . The main focus for Broly right now is helping train and power up Vegeta and Goku, but why would they not include him in ensuing fights? He’s clearly got the highest power ceiling of any of the fighters and can adapt quicker than any fighter. His problem is simply harnessing his abilities.

Plot wise it doesn’t make much sense for one of the series’ most powerful characters to stay on the bench for too long. Not to mention, Broly is a fan favorite. The next anime entry could time skip a bit to turn him into a more finished product. It also makes sense that Broly takes the next step in his leveling because the future enemies in the series should get stronger . The franchise is always topping prior power levels to make the stakes higher, so Broly will definitely get a fight in the near future.

His future story contains a lot of what-ifs that can be explored too. His short screen time in the movie only addressed his past briefly, which was all but spent on Vampa. However, it didn’t give enough insight into his full relationship with his father. It seemed like a complex situation, especially when most of what Paragus did to him was abusive. Broly clearly cared when Paragus died, but was that a result of him being the only person in his life? Or was there a genuine father-son relationship at one point?

What Transformation Comes Next?

Regardless of canon or non-canon, the creative team behind Dragon Ball anime isn’t afraid to take an idea that works and move it into the official timeline. Since the concept of Broly was introduced more than 30 years ago, he appeared as the Legendary Super Saiyan. Broly received the same treatment in Dragon Ball Super . Then, Super Dragon Ball Heroes dropped and evil Broly decided to ascend to Super Saiyan 3 and 4.

These power-ups might seem less than considering the level that Goku and Vegeta achieved now, but as everyone learned in the Broly movie, his first Super Saiyan form proved a challenge even for Super Saiyan Blue Gogeta. In what power tier could Super Saiyan 2, 3 and 4 be for Broly? Again, the potential is there for a lot of expansion. He is a moldable character due to him being stranded out of society for a long time.

The initial components of a good person and character are there. Broly is a Saiyan that shouldn’t even be alive, if King Vegeta had his way. He was spared and eventually persevered through a brutal upbringing to find a good example in Goku and Vegeta. Here’s to hoping Broly stays the course and continues to progress. Would you like to see more of Broly in Dragon Ball’ s anime future? Let us know in the comments.

title: Giant Ojosama TV Anime Reveals More Cast
content:
The official X/Twitter account for the television anime of Nikumura Q 's Giant Ojō-sama (Giant Young Lady) manga revealed on Friday that Rina Kawaguchi will play Stella, another giant girl. The account streamed a character trailer:

The account revealed last week that Risa Imayanagi will play Madoka Ito, a member of the "Secret Service," who also becomes a giant girl.

The anime stars:

• Yū Serizawa as Oriko Fujido

• Junya Enoki as Dr. Sebastian

Hiroshi Ikehata ( WITCH WATCH ) is directing the anime at Tatsunoko Production . Katsuya Oshima is serving as assistant director. Hajime Mitsuda ( Food for the Soul ) is the character designer and chief animation director. Yū Satō ( Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! ) is handling the series composition and script. Yūsuke Shirato ( Rumble Garanndoll ), Kijibato , and Aira ( Dream Monster ) are composing the music.

The additional staff includes:

• Art Design: Takashi Hiruma

• Art Director: Akira Itō (StudioARA)

• Color Setting: Misako Akama

• Photography: Masashi Kamiki (Studio Myu), Yōhei Konishi (Studio Twinkle)

• Editing: Akinori Mishima

• Animation Producer: Miki Kaneko

The story centers around Oriko Fujidō, the scion of an ultra-wealthy family who finds herself growing to gigantic proportions. She had received an entire town as a present on her fourth birthday, but one day, a giant invader attacks her town. Her butler Sebastian offers her a drink that transforms her into a giant, so she strives to protect her town — but just might end up destroying it, throwing the denizens' lives into chaos.

Nikumura Q has been serializing the Giant Ojō-sama manga since July 2020 on Shogakukan 's Sunday Webry service. Shogakukan published the manga's 13th compiled book volume on September 11. The manga was nominated by for best web manga in the eighth "Next Manga Awards" (Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Taishō) in 2022, and it ranked #5 in AnimeJapan's sixth "Most Wanted Anime Adaptation" poll the following year.

title: J-Novel Club Licenses Putting a Price on World Peace Novels, I'm Dating a Dark Summoner Manga, More Titles
content:
J-Novel Club announced on Friday it has added seven new light novel series and six new manga series to its digital lineup.

In addition, the company announced it will release Nahuse 's Rebuild World light novel series in print starting on April 27, 2027, and Micoto Sakurai and Levin Aoi 's A Royal Rebound: Forget My Ex-Fiancé, I'm Being Pampered by the Prince! manga in print starting on June 8, 2027.

The new light novel licenses include:

Life is stressful enough as it is, so she doesn't need a video game that stresses her out too. Determined to take things at her own pace, Kokoro immediately sets out to find the perfect way to chill. And what better way than to befriend a new cute, cuddly companion? Naturally, that means she'll need a Slime as her first partner.

Forget dangerous battles and daring adventures. For now, Kokoro and her Slime are here to use their time to the fullest—and it all begins with crafting potions!

For Shionne, life as a Soldier Maid is a never-ending cycle of dangerous missions and barely adequate hazard pay. But everything changes when her bosses at the White Sisterhood pair her up with Iris Whitespuria—a shy, eyepatched rookie with a mysterious past. Shionne isn't quite sure what to make of her new partner, and the more time they spend together, the more questions arise.

Who is Iris, really? Why were they paired together? What is she hiding? More importantly, what is the White Sisterhood hiding? Oh, and while she's at it, how can someone this annoying be this cute?!

Shionne is quickly realizing that she's out of her depths in more ways than one. There's only one thing she knows for sure: whatever's going on here is definitely above her pay grade.

There's just one problem: I'm only free on weekends. That leaves me with Saturdays and Sundays to explore this new world, consume its culinary delights, and put my magic to use. Who knows? Maybe I'll even find a girlfriend!

It's exactly what I need to recharge after clocking out for the week... Guess I'm working for a weekend getaway to another world!

In a world fraught with frequent attacks by void beasts, magical girls protect mankind. But because they must draw their power from the support of livestream viewers, these adolescent girls risk their lives in battle knowing that a lapse in judgment—or simply fading from the spotlight—could spell their demise. Society may have accepted this reality, but one man, Shiraha Takatsuka, won't tolerate such heavy responsibilities being forced onto their tiny shoulders! Enter the world's first fully grown man turned magical girl! Now a protector of other magical girls, Shiraha is ready to show the world what happens when a reliable grown-up joins the team to save the world!

Takeshi Sato is struggling to keep his supernatural detective agency afloat when inspiration strikes. VTubers rake in a ton of cash, right? So why not become one himself? With little more than superficial knowledge of the industry and his trusty ghost partner at his side, Takeshi makes his debut as Midnight Psychoknight under a famous VTuber agency.

Naturally, one disastrous debut stream later, and he's cemented as chat's favorite punching bag. But just when he thinks his new career is doomed, his fellow VTubers and real-life friends begin rallying around him. Before he knows it, he's finding his footing and his subscriber count is climbing!

And so the curtains rise on this supernatural comedy filled with wacky hijinks, ghostly mysteries, and one struggling detective's quest for viral stardom!

Trao may be a member of the S-rank adventurer party Blue Ring, but as a merchant, he doesn't have much to offer when it comes to combat. So when his comrades learn he's been dipping into the party's funds, they kick him out without a second thought. With nowhere else to go, Trao decides to follow the money—more specifically, the funds he's been redirecting to the all-female party Garnet.

His goal? To take down the Demon King! But this journey is off to a less-than-heroic start, as his new comrades' first order of business is looting the corpses of Trao's former party. With the Demon King's invasion threatening to engulf the world, this pragmatic merchant might just be the unlikely answer to humanity's prayers. After all, saving the world is just another business opportunity!

The new manga licenses include:

Itoko Tachibana is an inquisitive young lady who has already been rejected by two potential suitors for being decidedly unladylike. Now facing a third matchmaking meeting, she has little hope of finding a suitable match—let alone love. But her latest prospect, Shun Otori, is quite unlike any man she has encountered before.

A man shrouded in intrigue, Shun has his own reasons for seeking a bride, and his desire for marriage comes with some surprising strings attached. What's more, rumors are circulating that he's broken from his usual patterns to make a connection with Itoko. With society watching their every move and secrets lurking beneath the surface, Itoko must decide whether she will let others dictate her life or dare to let her budding feelings for Shun bloom.

Then disaster strikes when Kai is expelled from his party just as Nagi's condition suddenly worsens. Unless he can pay the enormous hospital fee that is quickly coming due, he may lose his sister forever.

Driven to desperation, Kai takes a gamble on an expedition into an unexplored Cube, risking everything for a reward that could change his fate. Can Kai arise from zero to hero and save his beloved sister? The answer may be right before his eyes...

But when Kazuno's house—and all of his classmates—are suddenly transported to a world of high fantasy, his quiet life is turned upside down. Determined to save those closest to him, Kazuno ventures forth and faces life in the wild... with all the comforts and conveniences of modern living, right at home. Turns out his house might just be the gift that keeps on giving!

Her former comrade, Wayne, urges her to dream of a different future, but Lacey has long since resigned herself to her fate. She's even prepared to burn her beloved staff to appease the man she's supposed to marry. Then one day, she and Wayne stumble upon her husband-to-be cheating on her with multiple women, including the princess!

As the scandal comes to light before the king, Lacey finds herself at a crossroads. After a lifetime of having her choices made for her, she finally takes the first step toward the one thing she's never had: the freedom to live for herself.

This unlikely couple—or not, as one of them would insist—must learn to work together professionally and personally. From tackling problems in the bedroom to exploring dungeons, catching notorious thieves, and fighting powerful monsters, these two are in for all sorts of adventures!
